title: Figure 18: ITER Design Concept With BWR Size and Blanket Segment
description: Color cutaway rendering of the ITER tokamak with an overlaid outline labeled 'ESBWR Vessel (6.4 m ID, 21 m H)' for size comparison, and a separate rendering of a curved blanket segment at right. The text explains the comparison with the GE Next-Generation Economic Simplified Boiling-Water Reactor published in an American Nuclear Society Fusion Energy Division newsletter (Dec 2007).
